assumptions: Established on this fixture by enumeration. The absorbing property itself follows from exact matching and holds generally; what is fixture-specific is that NO edge here declares a ⊤ antecedent or a complete additive table.
This does not say the exact-match choice was wrong. It says the choice has a cost that was not priced when it was made.
attrs.evidence: FOUND BY TRYING TO ASSERT `a discharged narrowing beats the baseline` FROM A SOURCE NODE, WHERE IT IS FALSE. The fixture’s three discharged narrowings fire when the closure is seeded AT A-EXTRACT, and never fire from any of the three source nodes S-MODEL, S-CORPUS, S-TOOLDEF — because A-EXTRACT is fed by two edges with no declared transfer, so it is ⊤ under every source seed, and ⊤ matches no exact rule on E5, E6 or E9. Seeded at a source, the typed closure equals untyped reachability at every node even though three narrowings are discharged. THE THREE DISCHARGED NARROWINGS ARE UNIT-REACHABLE AND SYSTEM-DEAD — the R5.2 latent-branch shape one level up: a branch a control executes and the system never reaches. THIS IS A CONSEQUENCE OF GPT-5.6’S OWN OPTION B THAT NEITHER SIDE ANTICIPATED. Under option A, the per-kind table R7.3 shipped, a ⊤ label DECOMPOSES per kind and downstream narrowings still apply; option B bought the ability to express synergy and paid for it in downstream precision recovery. The justification pattern that produces narrowings in practice — `a docnote records THAT extraction ran, not what it produced` — naturally writes small antecedents, not ⊤ antecedents, so this is a practical trap and not only a formal one.

attrs.review_focus: The open question this raises and does not answer: is a ⊤-antecedent rule a legitimate narrowing, or is `I can bound the impact of an invalidation I could not classify` a claim nobody should be allowed to discharge? If the latter, then precision requires a fully-operational path from seed to node and the frontier is a hard architectural bound rather than a fixture accident.
attrs.statement: There is a fixture in which every discharged narrowing is dead: seeded at any source node the typed closure equals untyped reachability at every node, although three narrowings are discharged. The cause is general — under exact-match semantics ⊤ is absorbing, matching no declared rule unless an edge declares an antecedent equal to the whole kind set, or is declared additive with a singleton rule for every kind.
